clean_macro_f1_bootstrap_ci.png.caption: Bars are frozen point estimates; error bars are 95% paired class-stratified percentile bootstrap intervals across 162 test instances, with CNN metrics averaged across all three frozen seeds within each resample.

clean_per_class_f1.png.caption: CNN bars are three-seed means; deterministic methods are single point estimates. No error bars are shown in this figure; exact seed SD and bootstrap intervals are tabulated.

data_efficiency_learning_curves.png.caption: Error bars are sample SD across three predeclared reduced-data replicates; full-data HOG/LBP SD is N/A and is not drawn as zero.

phase9_human_review_summary.png.caption: Percentages are one reviewer's post-hoc judgments on 60 deliberately selected cases; they are not objective ground truth or population estimates.

robustness_curves.png.caption: CNN curves are three-seed means; HOG/LBP are deterministic. Conditions are fixed synthetic design points, not random operational environments.

severe_per_class_f1.png.caption: CNN bars are three-seed means; deterministic bars are point estimates. Small class supports constrain interpretation.

severe_retention_heatmap.png.caption: Retention is corrupted macro-F1 divided by each method's clean macro-F1. It is a descriptive ratio on four fixed severe conditions.
